name: feel-english
description: Build an English-first sense for core words and chunks through contextual examples, production, recall, and durable study records.

interface.shortDescription: Learn core English words as context, chunks, and usable intuition.
interface.longDescription: A guided English practice plugin that develops direct, situation-based recall instead of one-to-one Korean translation. It prioritizes high-value core words, teaches their shared image through examples and chunks, drills sentence transformations and personal production, schedules retrieval practice, and saves progress in a user-configured Git repository.
defaultPrompt: 오늘의 핵심 단어와 chunk 학습을 시작해줘.
get을 번역어 암기 없이 문맥과 예문으로 연습시켜줘.
지금 하고 있는 일을 영어로 바로 떠올리는 연습을 해보자.
